resources.string: That source is no longer available. Choose a document again.

Try asking a specific question about the readable document text, or ask for a summary.
Set up and import the recommended compact model to use general chat. Document facts do not need a model.
There is not enough available memory for the compact model right now. Close other apps and try again, or ask about a selected document’s printed facts.
The local model could not finish this reply. Try a shorter message or clear the chat and try again.

The local reply did not pass the source-reference checks. Here are the actual relevant excerpts instead.
